sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: New Zealand energy and telecommunications provider offering electricity, gas, broadband and mobile services, with electricity generated from renewable sources.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Mercury provides electricity, gas, broadband and mobile services to homes and businesses in Aotearoa New Zealand. Its generation assets produce electricity from hydro, geothermal and wind sources, and the company also supports e.transport, sustainability and community initiatives.

sections.label: Mission
sections.content: Helping move Aotearoa New Zealand to a low emissions future and contributing to a more sustainable future.

sections.label: Founders & leadership
sections.content: Mercury has a Board of Directors and an Executive Team; the scraped content does not provide individual names.

sections.label: Voice & tone
sections.content: Energetic, approachable, community-focused and sustainability-led, with promotional and informative messaging.

sections.label: Parent ownership
sections.content: The New Zealand Government (the Crown) holds a legislated 51% of Mercury.

sections.label: Problem solved
sections.content: Provides household and business energy and connectivity services while supporting the transition to lower-emissions energy and transport.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Renewable electricity generation from hydro, geothermal and wind
Retail supply of electricity, gas, broadband and mobile services
Customer account management through the Mercury App and website
Customer help and support through FAQs, guides and service information
Electric vehicle and e.transport initiatives
Battery energy storage planning and grid-support projects
Community, iwi, environmental and sponsorship partnerships

sections.label: Products / SKUs
sections.content:
Electricity
Gas
Broadband
Mobile
Mercury Rewards
EV Discount

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Pricing is subject to change. The site mentions a free Samsung product offer for customers joining electricity and broadband on a two-year term, with terms, eligibility and early termination fees applying; router postage and handling is listed as $14.95.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Energy and telecommunications utilities, with e.transport and energy storage initiatives.

sections.label: Customer base
sections.content: Residential and business customers in Aotearoa New Zealand.

sections.label: Ideal customer profile
sections.content: New Zealand households and businesses seeking electricity, gas, broadband and mobile services, including customers interested in renewable energy, electric vehicles and sustainability.

sections.label: Use cases
sections.content:
Supplying household or business electricity
Supplying gas
Providing broadband connectivity
Providing mobile services
Managing services and accounts through the Mercury App or website
Rewarding customers through Mercury Rewards and Free Power Days
Supporting electric vehicle charging through discounted overnight electricity usage
Enabling renewable electricity generation and grid resilience through energy storage

sections.label: Customer outcomes
sections.content:
Access to electricity, gas, broadband and mobile services
Ability to manage accounts and services online or through the Mercury App
Opportunities to earn and redeem rewards, including Free Power Days
20% off variable household electricity usage between 9pm and 7am for eligible EV customers
Access to electricity generated from renewable sources
Support for lower-emissions transport and a more sustainable future
